INTE DATE
JAN [5 2025

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

ORDINANCE

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the RT4 Residential, Two-Flat, Townhouse and
Multi-Unit district District symbols and indications as shown on Map 24-B in the area
bounded by:

A Line 175 Feet North of and Parallel to East 96th Street; the public alley next
East of and parallel to South Commercial Avenue; A Line 150 Feet North of and parallel
to East 96th Street; and South Commercial Avenue.

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 9541 S. Commercial Avenue
